newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon construction activity up in March.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon construction activity up in March.

text.p: Construction activity picked up in March but remained well below last year's level, the Bank of Lebanon said in its monthly bulletin issued on Tuesday.

"Construction activity continued its annual decline as the area of construction permits approved in March by the Association of Engineers fell by 28.2 percent compared to the previous year," the bank said.
"However, reflecting seasonal activity it increased by 49.1 percent relative to February," it added.
Cement deliveries rose to 233,000 tonnes in March from 161,000 tonnes in February. They declined by 14.1 percent on a year-on-year basis.
Total real estate fees collected rose to 20.6 billion pounds from 12.8 billion a month earlier, the report added.
